An agency or a freelancer to build your website? A freelancer is often enough for a simple, clearly described project. An agency may be more convenient when the project requires several specializations, coordination or care after launch. The choice doesn't come down to deciding which model is better. What matters is the project scope, the competencies needed, the consequences of possible downtime and the support expected. Both an independent specialist and a team can work at different levels, so the final decision should concern a specific offer and contractor.
